title: Quant profile validation fabrication and canary runbook for INT8 WO (GPTQ/AWQ)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an end-to-end validation and canary runbook ('fabrication' pipeline) for integrating INT8 weight-only quant profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) into the serving runtime. The goal is to synthesize profiles, run multi-dim regressions across model families and HW stacks, and provide a deterministic smoke gate with automated fallback to FP8 or full-precision variants on failures.
acceptance_criteria: Automated profile synthesis job produces per-model INT8 profile artifacts with metadata (model, seed, kernel-hint, seqlen distributions) and is stored in the profile registry
Canary pipeline runs a smoke suite within 30 minutes and emits pass/fail signal to the rollout controller
Golden-answer delta is computed for each canary run and a threshold-based alert fires when QoL drift exceeds tolerance
Telemetry shows representative latency/cost impact and a rollback path is exercised in a simulated outage
Documentation and runbook (playbook) published to Confluence with checklist for on-call and release engineers
tasks: Design profile artifact schema and add fields for hardware_hint, quant_tool_version, cal_params
Implement profile synthesis job on calibration worker pool (k8s CronJob prototype)
Extend profile registry API to accept signed artifacts and store numeric fingerprints
Create regression harness that runs GPTQ/AWQ artifacts across 3 model families (Llama2-family, MPT-family, open-encoder-family)
Build canary workflow: shadow deploy -> smoke-suite -> golden-diff -> gates -> promote/rollback
Wire canary results to rollout controller and Console dashboard (per-route view)
Add chaos test that simulates kernel failover and verifies automatic fallback to FP8 or CPU path
Write automated notebooks that reproduce the top-5 failing prompts and seed states for investigations
Author runbook with step-by-step rollback and mitigation steps for runtime engineers
Coordinate security review and KMS signing flow for profile artifacts
comments: 2025-02-14 Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Q/INT8+Fabrication+Kickoff. Agreed scope: synthesis + canary + telemetry. Miles will lead engineering, Priya will lead evals.

2025-02-18 Miles Chen: POC for synthesis job completed. Uses calibration-worker image v1.5. Key trade-off: using larger synthetic prompt set increases coverage but lengthens runtime. Initial run: 120 models, 6 hours total on 8 GPUs.

2025-02-20 Priya Kapoor (Applied ML): Eval harness output: GPTQ profiles show 0.8% median answer-drift on general QA set, AWQ profiles show 1.1% median but 0.4% better latency. Suggest adding per-layer clipping heuristics to reduce outlier drift.

2025-02-22 Engineering review: Decided to include kernel-hint in profile metadata to allow runtime kernel swap. Trade-offs discussed: coupling profiles too tightly to kernel leads to brittle upgrades; mitigation: runtime will accept compatible kernel list and fall back when mismatch detected.

2025-02-25 UX feedback (Console team): Need a per-profile view showing training seed, cal parameters, golden-diff summary, and links to failing prompts. Created product ticket PM-412 for Console UI extension.

2025-02-27 Miles Chen: Canary workflow prototype submitted: github PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4873. Includes smoke-suite (100 prompts), golden-diff calculator, and webhook to rollout controller.

2025-02-28 SRE note (Lara Nguyen): Added outage simulation plan to test chaos fallback with two failure modes: kernel OOM and KV-cache corruption. We'll run against dedicated test cluster v-staging-3.
2025-03-01 Security (Omar Ruiz): Reviewed artifact signing flow. KMS integration required; documented steps and created key policy request (ticket SEC-2025-11).

2025-03-03 Miles Chen: Nightly run report attached to ticket. Summary: 3/50 canaries failed the golden-diff threshold on AWQ for long-seq chat prompts. Collected failing prompt seeds and attached traces. Next action: run layered clipping sweep and rerun canaries.
2025-03-03 Priya Kapoor: Note on metrics: add token-level log-prob delta and answer-fidelity score to telemetry to better diagnose model-level regressions.
notes: This ticket ties together calibration (synthesis), validation (regression harness), and the operational canary for safe rollout. Emphasis on deterministic reproductions for failures and minimal coupling of profiles to kernel implementations. Follow-up items will split into smaller tickets for dashboard UI, KMS policy, and chaos automation.
